Class TileFactory

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.tiles.TileFactory
public class TileFactory extends Object
A factory class for creating and managing Tile objects from JSON resources or string data. Provides methods for loading, deserializing, and organizing tile instances used in the game.
